code:
# All 5xx server errors
grep -E ' 5[0-9]{2} ' /var/log/northbridge/nginx-access.log

# All requests to the checkout endpoint
grep '/api/v1/checkout' /var/log/northbridge/nginx-access.log

# Count only -- how many 500s today?
grep -c ' 500 ' /var/log/northbridge/nginx-access.log
caption: -E enables extended regex: alternation and classes, no backslash escaping.

code:
# Status code is field 9 in Northbridge's log layout
awk '{print $9}' /var/log/northbridge/nginx-access.log

# Only lines slower than 1 second (field 11 = response time)
awk '$11 > 1.0 {print $7, $11}' /var/log/northbridge/nginx-access.log
caption: awk splits each line into whitespace-separated fields $1, $2, ...

steps.label: sort
steps.sub: groups identical values together -- required before uniq

steps.label: uniq -c
steps.sub: collapses each group into one line, prefixed with its count

steps.label: sort -rn
steps.sub: re-sorts those counts numerically, largest first

eyebrow: The full pipeline: top 5 error codes today
code:
grep -E ' [45][0-9]{2} ' /var/log/northbridge/nginx-access.log \
  | awk '{print $9}' \
  | sort \
  | uniq -c \
  | sort -rn \
  | head -5
caption: Filter 4xx/5xx, pull the status column, count, rank, keep the top 5.
